title: LANGUAGE AGENTS FOR DETECTING IMPLICIT STEREOTYPES IN TEXT-TO-IMAGE MODELS AT SCALE
findings: The study found that among the three social dimensions analyzed (gender, race, and religion), religion was the most heavily stereotyped. This was attributed to the scarcity of diverse religious content in training data and significant stereotype problems in societal and cultural contexts. The paper also noted that certain prompt types are correlated with particular religious subgroups; for example, prompts involving violence often generated images related to Muslims.
